Team —

As we finalize the Q2 forecast, Acme (ACME-2026-EXP-47) is looking like a marginal commit and I want to make sure we have a clear risk level and an actionable save plan. Please treat this as a commit-review item for Monday's forecast sync.

Quick summary:
- Forecasted close: 2026-03-31 (end of quarter)
- ARR at stake: $240k annualized
- Current CRM stage: Contracting (Verbal commit from Emma)

Immediate outstanding blockers:
- Procurement needs SOC2 evidence and updated DPA (Procurement team noted this on 2/24)
- Pricing/discount ask in negotiation (request for 10% promotional credit)
- Final PO and legal sign-off pending

Action items (please update by 2026-03-03 17:00 ET):
1) Update CRM stage/confidence % (Marcus)
2) Provide a 1-page save-plan with owners and dates (Marcus + Neha)
3) Finance: indicate whether this can stay as commit at 75% confidence or should be downgraded to yellow/red (Rishi)

I've attached my working deal-health workbook (acme-deal-health-q2.xlsx) and a save-plan template (acme-save-plan-draft.docx). Keep the language tight — we will present to finance at the 3/4 forecast review.

Thanks —
Laura
